summary: This directory defines the abstract contracts and infrastructure for rendering UI components. It serves as the foundation for library-specific implementations, providing the necessary interfaces to map generic UI requirements to concrete component libraries like Shadcn and Material UI.
responsibilities: Define common interfaces for UI component rendering
Establish contracts for field renderer components
Provide centralized access points for rendering logic
Decouple application UI requirements from specific component libraries
relationships: The renderer contract defines the expected input and behavior for specific UI rendering components.
Component mapping implementations consume the defined renderer types to ensure structural consistency across different UI libraries.
designDecisions: Use of functional component types for rendering logic
Centralized export patterns to provide a uniform API
Decoupling of rendering definitions from concrete library implementations
